project_description: WeChat Channels automation: collect videos and comments by filter, inspect Channels messages, and like, follow, comment, reply or message from a video's share link. Every task runs on its own. Keep the phone unlocked, awake and in portrait, and use foreground mode.
collect_channels_description: Collects videos one by one from recommendations or search results: author nickname, full description, time and place, the author's profile and Channels ID, the copied share link, and every comment including replies. Optional filter words keep only matching videos and comments; the run stops after 50 misses in a row. Commenter profiles are not visited. Data is kept on the phone for now.
collect_count_description: Only saved videos count; filtered-out ones do not.
collect_count_invalid: Enter a whole number from 1 to 500
collect_video_filter_description: Only videos whose description contains any of these words are collected. Separate words with spaces or commas; leave empty to collect every video.
collect_comment_filter_description: Only comments containing any of these words are saved, with the matched words in commentMatchedKeywords. Separate words with spaces or commas; leave empty to save every comment.
link_like_comment_description: Sends the link to File Transfer and opens the video from there (each run leaves the link message there), then likes the first comment by that nickname; an already liked comment is left as is.
link_reply_comment_description: Sends the link to File Transfer and opens the video from there (each run leaves the link message there), then replies to the first comment by that nickname. Each comment is replied to once.
link_message_commenter_description: Sends the link to File Transfer and opens the video from there (each run leaves the link message there), then opens the Channels profile of the first commenter with that nickname and sends a message. Each person is messaged once; a WeChat user without a Channels account has no message button and the task fails.
inspect_messages_description: Opens the Channels feed → personal page → Channels messages → Comments, handles notifications not handled before (like, reply) and returns to the feed.
messages_reply_description: Leave empty to like without replying.
link_like_video_description: Sends the link to File Transfer and opens the video from there (each run leaves the link message there), then likes (thumb) and hearts it; ones already done are skipped.
link_follow_author_description: Sends the link to File Transfer and opens the video from there (each run leaves the link message there), then follows the author from their profile; an existing follow is kept.
link_message_author_description: Sends the link to File Transfer and opens the video from there (each run leaves the link message there), then sends the author a message from their profile. Each author is messaged once; WeChat allows one message until they reply.
link_comment_video_description: Sends the link to File Transfer and opens the video from there (each run leaves the link message there), then posts a comment under it. Each video is commented on once.
